{"code": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests
from matplotlib import font_manager

url = "https://push2his.eastmoney.com/api/qt/stock/kline/get"
params = {
    "secid": "1.600519", "fields1": "f1,f2,f3,f4,f5,f6",
    "fields2": "f51,f52,f53,f54,f55,f56,f57,f58,f59,f60,f61",
    "klt": "101", "fqt": "1", "beg": "20251001", "end": "20261024",
}
j = requests.get(url, params=params, headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"}, timeout=30).json()
rows = [k.split(",") for k in j["data"]["klines"]]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["date","open","close","high","low","volume","amount","amplitude","pct","chg","turnover"])
for c in ["open","close","high","low","volume","amount","amplitude","pct","chg","turnover"]:
    df[c] = df[c].astype(float)
df["date"] = pd.to_datetime(df["date"])
df = df.set_index("date").sort_index()

close = df["close"]
start, end = close.index[0], close.index[-1]
p0, p1 = close.iloc[0], close.iloc[-1]
total_ret = (p1/p0 - 1)*100
high, low = df["high"].max(), df["low"].min()
high_date = df["high"].idxmax().date(); low_date = df["low"].idxmin().date()

# moving averages
for w in [5,10,20,60]:
    df[f"MA{w}"] = close.rolling(w).mean()

# drawdown
cummax = close.cummax()
dd = (close/cummax - 1)
maxdd = dd.min()*100
maxdd_date = dd.idxmin().date()

# volatility (annualized)
rets = close.pct_change().dropna()
ann_vol = rets.std()*np.sqrt(252)*100

print(f"区间: {start.date()} ~ {end.date()}  ({len(df)} 个交易日)")
print(f"起始收盘 {p0:.2f} -> 最新收盘 {p1:.2f}")
print(f"区间涨跌幅 {total_ret:+.2f}%")
print(f"区间最高 {high:.2f} ({high_date})  区间最低 {low:.2f} ({low_date})")
print(f"最大回撤 {maxdd:.2f}% ({maxdd_date})")
print(f"年化波动率 {ann_vol:.2f}%")
print(f"最新MA5 {df['MA5'].iloc[-1]:.2f}  MA20 {df['MA20'].iloc[-1]:.2f}  MA60 {df['MA60'].iloc[-1]:.2f}")
print(f"最新收盘 vs MA60: {close.iloc[-1]-df['MA60'].iloc[-1]:+.2f}")
# 近3个月 (最近约63个交易日)
recent = close.iloc[-63:]
print(f"近3个月涨跌 {(recent.iloc[-1]/recent.iloc[0]-1)*100:+.2f}%")

# 分季度表现
q = close.resample("QE").last()
print("\n季度收盘:")
print(q.round(2))

# CJK font check
cjk = sorted({f.name for f in font_manager.fontManager.ttflist if any(k in f.name for k in ["CJK","Hei","Song","WenQuanYi","Noto Sans SC","PingFang","Microsoft YaHei","SimHei"])})
print("\nCJK fonts:", cjk if cjk else "NONE")
"}
